verify_sound.detail: Nonempty Alice-to-Bob attachment, single chunk; output-size and no-collision premises proved for an explicit three-output hash model, not SHA-256. A same-size tampered slice at a valid index is rejected by the hash comparison, an out-of-range index by the range check. The two-chunk climb under real SHA-256 is exercised in tests/vacuity/Attachment.lean.

complete_assembles.detail: Nonempty one-chunk file with every verification premise proved; reconstructed bytes equal the original. Explicit hash model, not SHA-256.

no_injective_hash.detail: Concrete 32-byte-output hash proves size premise; global injectivity is impossible even though nothing checked against this file collides with its tree.

assumptions_hold.detail: Applies the empty-file satisfiability theorem (a model hash with no collision against anything checked) and proves the nonempty-file extension. Explicit model hash; the real SHA-256 premise is decided on concrete bytes in tests/vacuity/Attachment.lean.
